## Reading first

A pigment-inspired palette rooted in *Moby-Dick*. Warm paper on one end,
deep ink on the other, with eight accent hues named after the crew of the
*Pequod*.

> Call me Ishmael.

## A little code

```python
def loss(theta, x, y):
    """Mean squared error for a linear model."""
    return ((x @ theta - y) ** 2).mean()
```

::: {.callout-note}
This is the dark variant — ink ground, paper text, dark crew accents.
